description: Generates a small fixed offset and a slow wander, both different for every polyphonic channel, for giving the voices of a synth the drift of an analogue one

params.text: Sets how large the fixed per-channel offset is, 0 to 1, the setting squared before it is applied; at the top it reaches ±5V
Draws a new set of fixed offsets, one per channel
Sets how far the slow wander goes, 0 to 1, the setting squared before it is applied
Sets how fast the wander moves, 0.01Hz at fully counter-clockwise to 1000Hz at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Sets how many channels the output carries; nothing on this jack is read except its channel count

outputs.text: The fixed offset and the wander added together, clamped to -10V and 10V, one value per channel

notes: the fixed offsets are saved with the patch, so a patch drifts the same way each time it is opened until the RNG button is pressed
with nothing patched to the Poly jack the output carries a single channel

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads one channel.
